evidence_direction_note: Governance 2026-08-21 gov-20260821-0203 ratified failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-939_2026-08-20.json: V3-EXQ-939 is the owed MECH-303 behavioural retest, unblocked by SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING landing 2026-08-14 (status_phase validated, its sole failure_record item already resolved). Its self-route substrate_not_ready_requeue and its degeneracy_reason ('the mechanism could not express itself, so nothing was measured') are REJECTED by this autopsy: the same manifest contains the clean 2x2 dissociation that refutes them -- A_safe_gate_natural 0.43889, B_safe_gate_forced_closed 0.0, C_hazard_gate_natural 0.0, D_hazard_gate_forced_open 0.45, with num_safety_steps 240/0/6/240 exactly as designed. All three pre-registered DVs PASSED, each clearing the 0.34 margin by ~0.10 (DV1 0.43889, DV2 0.45, DV3 0.43889), with criteria_non_degenerate true on all three, including DV3 which the driver names as the genuinely non-analytic one. The run was voided by a single readiness precondition missing by 0.0067, and that gate is defective three independent ways, all verified in source. (1) It aggregates by MIN (all(r >= floor), line 561) while the DVs it guards aggregate by MEAN (line 539) -- the same statistic, so the V3-EXQ-643 rule is met in letter, but the gate is strictly harsher than the criterion it guards, and the docstring's stated intent is a best-case check while the implementation reads the worst cell. (2) Its threshold is unreachable on the measurement lattice: N_TEST_TRIALS = 30 quantises release_rate to multiples of 1/30, so 0.34 lies strictly between 10/30 = 0.33333 (fails) and 11/30 = 0.36667 (passes); the effective floor is 0.3667, a silent 7.8% tightening, and seed 1 missed by 0.2 of a single trial. (3) MIN_VALID_SEEDS = 4, a pre-registered tolerance for up to 2 failing seeds of 6, computed 5 >= 4 and can never bind, because readiness_ok already requires every cell to clear the same floor -- the tolerance was vetoed by a zero-tolerance conjunction. Recorded but unresolved: the queue entry's 1-seed calibration reported A 0.900 / D 1.000 against a realised A 0.439 / D 0.45, roughly half, at identical config and a single driver commit.
